_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Conservative administration (12 Feb 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 and formed the Executive 28 May 2026, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.

administration.next_elections: Greater Essex devolution: a five-unitary model + a Greater Essex Mayor are due from 2028, so the county tier is time-limited.
administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (53 of 78; gained 52 seats from 1) and formed the Executive at the AGM on 28 May 2026. Essex's May 2025 election was postponed by a year for devolution / LGR. Composition: Reform 53, Conservative 13-14, Liberal Democrat 5-6, Independent 2, Green 1, Labour 1, Residents for Uttlesford 1, People's Independent Party 1. Leader of the Opposition: Conservative (Cllr Kevin Bentley lost his seat; successor to confirm).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114, no Exceptional Financial Support, no Best Value Notice). Budget inherited from the outgoing Conservative administration.
mtfs._source: Essex CC Annual Plan and Budget 2026/27 (public PDF on essex.gov.uk), set 12 Feb 2026.
